cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(EdgeFHE_V7_Unified_Integration LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
find_package(OpenFHE 1.5.1 EXACT CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(OpenSSL 3 REQUIRED)
get_filename_component(SSL_LIBDIR "${OPENSSL_CRYPTO_LIBRARY}" DIRECTORY)
add_subdirectory(baseline)
foreach(name bridge_selftest tls_unified_client)
 add_executable(${name} ${name}.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE edgefhe_v7 OpenSSL::SSL OpenSSL::Crypto)
 target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-misleading-indentation -fno-fast-math)
 target_link_options(${name} PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
 set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR};${SSL_LIBDIR}")
endforeach()
# Secure-profile device gate (added 2026-10-12). The _mock variant is an offline local test only.
foreach(name device_secure_selftest device_secure_selftest_mock)
 add_executable(${name} device_secure_selftest.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE edgefhe_v7 OpenSSL::SSL OpenSSL::Crypto)
 target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-misleading-indentation -fno-fast-math)
 target_link_options(${name} PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
 set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR};${SSL_LIBDIR}")
endforeach()
target_compile_definitions(device_secure_selftest_mock PRIVATE EDGEFHE_DEVICE_MOCK=1)
# Off-board math property and pipeline tests (added 2026-10-13).
foreach(name math_property_selftest pipeline_selftest slot_order_selftest caps_policy_selftest fast_path_selftest)
 add_executable(${name} ${name}.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE edgefhe_v7 OpenSSL::SSL OpenSSL::Crypto)
 target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-misleading-indentation -fno-fast-math)
 target_link_options(${name} PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
 set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR};${SSL_LIBDIR}")
endforeach()
# Performance + parallelism device gate (added 2026-10-14). The _mock variant is an offline local test only.
foreach(name device_perf_selftest device_perf_selftest_mock)
 add_executable(${name} device_perf_selftest.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE edgefhe_v7 OpenSSL::SSL OpenSSL::Crypto)
 target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-misleading-indentation -fno-fast-math)
 target_link_options(${name} PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
 set_target_properties(${name} PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR};${SSL_LIBDIR}")
endforeach()
target_compile_definitions(device_perf_selftest_mock PRIVATE EDGEFHE_DEVICE_MOCK=1)
# Lock-free sampler test (added 2026-10-14). edgefhe_det_prng_test is a TEST-ONLY deterministic engine.
add_library(edgefhe_det_prng_test SHARED det_prng_test.cpp)
target_include_directories(edgefhe_det_prng_test PRIVATE ${OpenFHE_INCLUDE}/core)
target_compile_options(edgefhe_det_prng_test PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
add_executable(sampler_selftest sampler_selftest.cpp)
target_link_libraries(sampler_selftest PRIVATE edgefhe_v7 ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
target_compile_options(sampler_selftest PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-misleading-indentation -fno-fast-math)
target_link_options(sampler_selftest PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
set_target_properties(sampler_selftest PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR}")
# perf3 ablation gate (added 2026-10-14). The _mock variant is an offline local test only.
foreach(name device_perf3_selftest device_perf3_selftest_mock)

 target_link_options(${name} PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")

endforeach()
target_compile_definitions(device_perf3_selftest_mock PRIVATE EDGEFHE_DEVICE_MOCK=1)
# Reference baseline R1 (added 2026-10-15): stock OpenFHE CKKS/BFV/BGV on the same CPU; no device.
add_executable(reference_baseline_selftest reference_baseline_selftest.cpp)
target_link_libraries(reference_baseline_selftest PRIVATE edgefhe_v7)
target_compile_options(reference_baseline_selftest PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-misleading-indentation -fno-fast-math)
target_link_options(reference_baseline_selftest PRIVATE "-Wl,--disable-new-dtags")
set_target_properties(reference_baseline_selftest PROPERTIES BUILD_RPATH "${OpenFHE_LIBDIR}")
# E02 sampler profile + candidate-A equivalence (added 2026-10-15). CPU only; det mode needs the TEST-ONLY engine.
add_executable(sampler_profile_selftest sampler_profile_selftest.cpp)
target_link_libraries(sampler_profile_selftest PRIVATE edgefhe_v7 ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
target_compile_options(sampler_profile_selftest PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -Wno-misleading-indentation -fno-fast-math)

# perf4 gate (added 2026-10-15): fair common sink + sampler ablation. The _mock variant is an offline local test only.

# The _mock variant runs the V8b specification model (offline local test only).
foreach(name device_v8b_selftest device_v8b_selftest_mock)
